version.description: DESC-9. A single integer; there is no minor version. DESC-29 makes it count breaking changes to this Capability's own surface alone.

address.title: Address
address.description: DESC-12. An absolute https URL, or a relative reference resolved against the Descriptor's own URL. DESC-13 governs whether a credential may be sent to one that is off-origin.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: MET-6. An IANA Time Zone Database name — `America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires`, `UTC`. A fixed offset is not one: an offset cannot say when a day begins across a daylight-saving transition, which is the whole reason the zone is declared. This is the calendar a caller gets when the Worker has agreed no other with it.

metrics.description: MET-2. Every metric the Worker publishes, keyed by name. A name not here is `404` under MET-9. The key carries no pattern: it is spelled into the VALUE of a query parameter, which is percent-encoded, and naming.md leaves a Worker's own names alone.

title: Metrics capability entry
description: MET-1. The shared Capability entry with the address required, the time zone every bucket boundary is cut in, and the metrics this Worker publishes.
